references.text: The priest shall examine the wound and see if it has penetrated deeper than the skin, just as the spot in the house wall appears to be deeper than the wall.
Describes greenish or reddish spots on garments, using the same color description applied to spots on house walls.
The context for inspecting a house, where the homeowner reports possible leprosy in the house to the priest.
The priest examines whether the wound is deeper than the skin, parallel to checking if the spot in the wall is deeper than the surface.
Reminder to follow the priests' instructions regarding leprosy, which include inspecting houses.
